generation.hypothesis: Degradation will be governed by formation and eventual loss of transport control by a continuous Cr2O3-rich scale. Aging-induced Cr depletion and interfaces will delay this barrier, while high-temperature defect-assisted oxygen penetration could accelerate internal oxidation and promote failure.
generation.material_initial_state: The starting material will be >97%-dense, selective-laser-melted Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 made from prealloyed powder, with a single-fcc cellular matrix and dislocation-rich cell walls.
generation.intervention: The as-printed state will be compared with direct aging at 750°C for 50 h, expected to produce about 25–30 vol% Ni/Ti-rich L12 nanoprecipitates and larger Al/Ti-rich, Cr/Fe-depleted L21 precipitates near cell walls.
generation.conditions: Polished 7.5 × 7.5 × 3 mm specimens will undergo isothermal oxidation for up to 96 h at 600, 750, 900, 1050, and 1200°C; the gas composition will remain unspecified.
generation.structural_mediator: A duplex-to-trilayer scale should comprise outer elemental and mixed/spinel oxides, continuous Cr-rich Cr2O3, and discontinuous inner Al/Ti-rich oxide.
generation.mechanism: Mobile Cr should diffuse outward and form the principal barrier. Lower-mobility Al3+ and Ti4+, present at low concentrations, should not form continuous layers. Aged interfaces and Cr-depleted precipitates may delay Cr2O3 formation and provide oxygen short circuits; above 900°C, defects, cracks, and grain boundaries may feed rapid inner oxidation.
generation.predicted_outcome: Aging should increase mass gain, increasingly with temperature, but both states should retain similar activation energies of about 150–155 kJ/mol. Expected mass-gain exponents will span roughly 0.25–0.65; growth above 900°C should approach parabolic behavior.
generation.baseline: The unaged fcc alloy should form protective Cr-rich oxide earlier because Cr will be comparatively uniform.
generation.boundary: Protection should be strongest through about 900°C; predictions apply only to 600–1200°C and exposures no longer than 96 h.
generation.uncertainty: Unspecified oxidation-gas composition may alter scale stability and transport.
